description: Synthetic streaming catalog and household history for one account, generated by replaying a fixed seeded sequence of the App's own tools and events. A reusable acceptance fixture, not a benchmark task.

sources.description: People, titles, episode names, synopses and plans are invented and hand-written in scripts/build-fixtures.cjs; dates, what each profile watched and the order of events come from a seeded generator that replays the App's handlers. No external collection.

transformations: IDs created by the replay are renamed to history IDs and the run counters reset to zero.
Catalog records (titles, seasons, episodes, plans) are written directly; everything the household did is replayed through the App's tools and events.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism and of whether every person, title and episode name is invented.
